headline: BONANZA AT MT STIRLING: GoldArc Resources (ASX:GA8) Punches 106 g/t Gold — Grade Control Confirms Mine Plan
snippet: GoldArc Resources (ASX:GA8) reported a 106 g/t gold intercept at hole BMLRC767 at its Mt Stirling deposit in Western Australia — the highest individual grade in the entire 34,000m partner-funded grade control program so far. BML Ventures is funding the campaign in full under a 50/50 net profit share, meaning no dilution for shareholders. An updated resource and open-pit study are expected through 2026.

headline: KOSSOU EXPANDS: Kobo Resources (KRI-V) Hits 75 g/t Gold, Eyes H2 2026 Maiden Resource in West Africa
snippet: Kobo Resources (TSX-V: KRI) released May 26 drill results from its Kossou Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire including 2.0m at 75.29 g/t Au — and 1.0m at 150 g/t — within the Jagger Zone, plus step-out holes extending strike by 150m. With 42,000m drilled across 222 holes and a second rig arriving in June, the company is targeting a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate in H2 2026.

headline: AUSTRAL GOLD FY26 UPDATE: Casposo Ramp-Up Drives +43% Revenue, Guidance Set at 27,000–33,000 GEOs
snippet: Austral Gold (ASX:AGD / TSX-V:AGLD) delivered its AGM Chair's Address on May 28 with Q1 2026 GEO production of 7,335 units and revenue of US$34.1 million — up 43% quarter-on-quarter, driven by the Casposo mine ramp-up in Argentina and higher realised gold and silver prices. Full-year 2026 guidance is set at 27,000–33,000 GEOs.

headline: URANIUM SLIDES to $84.95/lb — Utility Spot Buying Stalls as Market Marks 2-Month Low
snippet: Uranium spot eased to $84.95/lb on May 26 — the lowest in nearly two months — as utilities remain heavily reliant on long-term contracts and muted spot activity caps prices despite strong structural demand. Eagle Nuclear Energy is advancing the largest conventional measured-and-indicated uranium deposit in the US toward pre-feasibility, with a 27,000-foot drill campaign set for Q3 2026.

headline: SCOTLAND NI-CU-CO: Winshear Metals (WINS-V) Completes Phase 1 Drill at Portsoy — Downhole EM Surveyed
snippet: Winshear Metals (TSX-V: WINS) completed its Phase 1 drill program at the Portsoy Nickel-Copper-Cobalt project in Scotland on May 26, comprising six holes totalling 1,235.6m across the North and South zones. A downhole EM survey has been completed to refine Phase 2 targets; assay results are pending. Portsoy is one of only a handful of active Ni-Cu-Co exploration programs in Western Europe.

headline: RATIO WATCH: Silver's Wild May — Why "Stop Chasing the Number" Is Sound Advice Right Now
snippet: The gold-silver ratio compressed from 62:1 to 55:1 in a single week in May as the US-China tariff truce sparked a surge to multi-month highs — then reversed sharply. GoldSilver.com argues that silver's simultaneous role as monetary metal, industrial commodity, and speculative vehicle makes momentum-chasing dangerous at current levels. Two catalysts to watch: the June 16–17 FOMC meeting and whether the 90-day tariff window survives.

headline: PRECIOUS METALS RALLY SETUP? Market Indicators Aligning — What GoldSeek Sees Next
snippet: GoldSeek analysis points to a cluster of market indicators historically associated with precious metals bottoming and rallying: commercial short positioning in gold and silver pulling back from extremes, real yields compressing, and central bank buy programmes intact. Gold has not sustained a close below $4,400 — a level analysts describe as the make-or-break line for the next directional move.

headline: MINER STOCKS vs. METAL: Analysts Say Gold Equities Finally Closing the Valuation Gap
snippet: With gold 16% off its January 28 all-time high of US$5,589 but holding near US$4,400 — still well above most producers' all-in sustaining costs — analysts argue that sector undervaluation, M&A momentum, and margin expansion create a compelling setup for gold equity outperformance over the metal itself. Goldman Sachs targets $5,400/oz by December 2026, implying record free cash flow for quality producers at current cost structures.
